newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Siemens unit sees loss of 60-100 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Siemens unit sees loss of 60-100 mln DM.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Tuesday its locomotive unit, hurt by restructuring costs of 70 million marks, expected a loss of 60 million to 100 million marks in 1996/97.
Siemens transport technology unit (VT) has budgeted for a loss of 80 million marks, but the setback could fall to as low as 20 million marks "if things go well," unit chief Wolfram Martinsen said.

VT, which had pretax profit of 19 million in 1995/96, planned to cut headquarters staff in Germany by 30 percent this year to reduce costs, Martinsen said. With the cost reductions, a profit would be possible in 1997/98, he said.
